objects.description: Enumeration of CPU microarchitectures across vendors and ISAs. Values encode vendor/family groupings.
Logical processor descriptor with OS IDs, topology links to core/cluster/package, optional APIC ID, and pointers to the caches it uses.
CPU core descriptor: maps to a range of logical processors, belongs to a cluster and package, records vendor/uarch and an identifying register (CPUID/MIDR) plus nominal frequency.
Grouping of cores (e.g., big.LITTLE cluster). Provides index ranges for processors and cores, vendor/uarch, identifying register, and nominal frequency.
Physical package/SoC descriptor containing model name and index ranges for processors, cores, and clusters on the package.
Aggregated counts and identifying register for a microarchitecture present in the system, with counts of processors and cores of that uarch.

Internal, platform-conditional capability bitmap for x86/x86_64 ISA features. Exposed as extern variable cpuinfo_isa and queried via inline helpers. Not part of the stable API and should not be constructed by users.
Internal capability bitmap for ARM/ARM64 ISA extensions, conditionally including fields per sub-ISA. Exposed as extern variable cpuinfo_isa; queried via inline helpers.
Internal capability bitmap for RISC-V ISA base and standard extensions; exposed as extern cpuinfo_isa for inline feature queries.

functions.name: cpuinfo_initialize
functions.description: Initializes the cpuinfo library and gathers CPU topology/feature data. Expected usage: call once early in program startup before querying cpuinfo getters. Returns true on successful initialization, false on failure.
requirements: May be called before using any cpuinfo_get_* or capability-query helpers (inferred from typical library patterns; not explicitly stated).
Caller must check the boolean return value and handle initialization failure.

functions.name: cpuinfo_deinitialize
functions.description: Deinitializes the cpuinfo library and releases any resources allocated during initialization. Intended to be called at program shutdown.
requirements: Should be called only after a successful cpuinfo_initialize (inferred; not explicitly stated).
No return value; caller cannot detect errors.
After deinitialization, previously returned pointers from cpuinfo_get_* may become invalid (inferred; not explicitly stated).
Thread-safety and multiple invocations behavior are unknown.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_rdtsc
functions.description: Reports if the x86 RDTSC instruction is available. Always true on x86_64; on 32-bit x86 returns true on Android or reflects detected ISA; false on non-x86.
requirements: Meaningful (potentially true) only when compiling for x86/x86_64.
No arguments; can be called anytime.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_rdtscp
functions.description: Reports if the x86 RDTSCP instruction is available. Returns detected ISA value on x86/x86_64; false on other architectures.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_rdpid
functions.description: Reports if the x86 RDPID instruction is available. False on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_clzero
functions.description: Reports if the x86 CLZERO instruction (cache line zero) is available (primarily AMD). False on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_mwait
functions.description: Reports if the x86 MWAIT instruction is available. False on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_mwaitx
functions.description: Reports if the x86 MWAITX instruction is available (AMD). False on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_fxsave
functions.description: Reports if the x86 FXSAVE/FXRSTOR instructions are available for saving x87/SSE state. False on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_xsave
functions.description: Reports if the x86 XSAVE/XRSTOR state-management feature is available. False on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_fpu
functions.description: Reports if the x86 FPU is present. Always true on x86_64 and on Android x86; else reflects detected ISA; false on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_mmx
functions.description: Reports if x86 MMX is available. Always true on x86_64 and Android x86; else reflects detected ISA; false on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_mmx_plus
functions.description: Reports if x86 MMX extensions (aka MMX+) are available. Always true on x86_64 and Android x86; else reflects detected ISA; false on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_3dnow
functions.description: Reports if AMD 3DNow! is available. False on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_3dnow_plus
functions.description: Reports if AMD 3DNow! extensions are available. False on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_3dnow_geode
functions.description: Reports if Geode-specific 3DNow! is available. Always false on x86_64 and Android x86; reflects detected ISA on other x86; false on non-x86.
requirements: Meaningful only on 32-bit x86 (non-Android) to possibly return true.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_prefetch
functions.description: Reports if PREFETCH instructions are available on x86. False on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_prefetchw
functions.description: Reports if PREFETCHW is available on x86. False on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_prefetchwt1

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_daz

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_sse
functions.description: Reports if SSE is available. Always true on x86_64 and Android x86; else reflects detected ISA; false on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_sse2
functions.description: Reports if SSE2 is available. Always true on x86_64 and Android x86; else reflects detected ISA; false on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_sse3
functions.description: Reports if SSE3 is available. On Android returns true; else reflects detected ISA on x86/x86_64; false on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_ssse3
functions.description: Reports if SSSE3 is available. On Android returns true; else reflects detected ISA on x86/x86_64; false on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_sse4_1
functions.description: Reports if SSE4.1 is available. On Android x86_64 returns true; otherwise reflects detected ISA on x86/x86_64; false on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_sse4_2
functions.description: Reports if SSE4.2 is available. On Android x86_64 returns true; otherwise reflects detected ISA on x86/x86_64; false on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_sse4a

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_misaligned_sse
functions.description: Reports if misaligned SSE access support is present on x86. False on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_avx
functions.description: Reports if AVX is available on x86. False on non-x86.
requirements: Runtime use of AVX requires OSXSAVE and XSAVE enabled; this function only reports CPU capability per header, not usage constraints (implicit).

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_avxvnni

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_fma3

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_fma4

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_f16c

functions.name: cpuinfo_has_x86_avx2
functions.description: Reports if AVX2 is available on x86. False on non-x86.

functions.name: cpuinfo_get_current_processor
functions.description: Identifies the logical processor currently executing the calling thread. The result is only a hint and may change immediately; caller must handle NULL.
requirements: Caller must be prepared for a NULL return.
Do not assume the thread remains on the same processor after the call.

functions.name: cpuinfo_get_current_core
functions.description: Identifies the core currently executing the calling thread. The result is only a hint and may change immediately; caller must handle NULL.
requirements: Caller must be prepared for a NULL return.
Do not assume the thread remains on the same core after the call.

functions.name: cpuinfo_get_current_uarch_index
functions.description: Returns the microarchitecture index of the core currently executing the thread. Returns 0 if unsupported. Only a hint; may change as the thread migrates.
requirements: Caller must handle a 0 return value (unsupported).
Do not assume the thread remains on the same uarch after the call.

functions.name: cpuinfo_get_current_uarch_index_with_default
functions.description: Returns the microarchitecture index of the current core, or returns the provided default_uarch_index if the system does not support such identification. Only a hint; may change upon migration.
requirements: Provide a valid default_uarch_index to use when unsupported.
Do not assume the thread remains on the same uarch after the call.
